deviations_from_frozen_guide.what: P4 instantiated with SLOT_WORDS=81920 (640KiB, 4KiB aligned stride) and SLOT_BASE_WORD=2048 (byte 0x1_0000) instead of 81085 / base 0
deviations_from_frozen_guide.why: ddr_frame_pusher's ARM rule requires ddr_base != 0 AND ddr_base[11:0]==0; 81085 words = 2,594,720B is not a 4KiB multiple so slot 1 could never be exported, and base 0 is rejected
deviations_from_frozen_guide.scope: parameter override only; P4 r2 sources unchanged
deviations_from_frozen_guide.needs: planner ratification, or a changed pusher rule / slot mapping

deviations_from_frozen_guide.what: the bridge PAXI address is multiplied by 4 ({paxi_addr, 2'b00}) before the DDR AXI port
